title: French Mandatory in Work Relations
summary: For an operation headquarters in a French-language region, outside municipalities with facilities, prepare work documents in French. Another language can be used in addition.
body: Article 2 of the Decree of June 30, 1982 requires French in social relations and in acts and documents of the business prescribed by laws and regulations. It allows the supplementary use of a language chosen by the parties and strikes any clause restricting the use of French as null.

Verify the operation headquarters to which the worker is assigned. The 1986 constitutional repeals notably removed the criteria based solely on registered office or sole French expression of the worker and excluded municipalities with facilities from the scope of the decree.

According to article 3, documents contrary to article 2 are null and the judge notes this nullity ex officio. Regularization produces its effects only on delivery of a version compliant with the parties. The text entered into force on September 6, 1982.

title: Non-Discrimination in Placement and Employment Aids
summary: Apply the Walloon Decree of November 6, 2008 in the regional matters of recruitment, placement, training and employment aids. Provide the reasonable accommodations necessary for candidates with disabilities.
body: Article 5 notably addresses placement, vocational training, employment aids and employment of foreign workers, within the limits of regional competences. It also covers labor relations of the Walloon public services and organizations concerned. It does not replace the federal laws applicable to private employment.

Article 15 prohibits direct and indirect discrimination, discriminatory instructions, harassment and refusal of reasonable accommodation. Protected criteria include age, disability, health status, origin, language and beliefs. Remove any legally unjustified exclusions from ads and pre-selections.

Article 13 requires appropriate adjustments to access employment or training, except disproportionate burden. Public aid sufficiently compensating for this burden falls within the assessment. The consolidated version consulted has been in force since August 17, 2024.

title: Job Plus: New Incentive Since July 2026
summary: Since July 1, 2026, verify access to Job Plus for a new hire. The Walloon portal announces the replacement of the Impulsion, SESAM, Tremplin and SINE schemes.
body: The official information published on July 1, 2026 presents aid open to public and private sectors, targeting people far from employment. Eligibility depends notably on registration with Le Forem, age, qualifications and any recognition of reduced capabilities.

The base amount announced is 1,000 euros per month, prorated according to work time, with a minimum of half-time. An increase of 200 euros concerns companies with fewer than 20 full-time equivalents. Depending on the profile, the announced duration ranges from 12 to 36 months.

The employer must notably maintain the hiring for at least three months, at least half-time. Verify the entitlement and amount on the Le Forem platform, then submit the application. For former aids, separately verify the transitional provisions instead of assuming automatic transfer.

title: Impulsion -25 Years and 12 Months+: Current Rights
summary: Impulsion -25 Years and Impulsion 12 Months+ no longer allow opening a new benefit since July 1, 2026. The ONEM sheet remains useful for managing already-granted allowances.
body: Sheet T40, updated July 1, 2026, announces the repeal for new benefits and the extinction of ongoing benefits no later than December 31, 2029. Do not present these aids as accessible to a new recruitment in September 2026.

In files still under transitional arrangements, the work allowance constitutes a subsidy that the employer can deduct from net salary. The contractual conditions indicated since July 1, 2023 are a permanent contract or fixed-term contract of at least two months. The contract and Impulsion annex must be signed together.

The application goes through the mutual fund or trade union and must reach ONEM within two months following the month work begins. Verify the individual decision before any deduction in payroll, especially when changing contracts. Old procedural instructions do not reopen a right that has been removed.

title: Impulsion 55+: Closure and ONSS Transition
summary: The Walloon reduction for older workers is closed to new hires since July 1, 2026. Prior rights may persist, under conditions, until December 31, 2029 at the latest.
body: ONSS Instructions 2026/3 concern units of establishment in the Walloon Region, excluding the German-speaking Community. No new entrant is admitted from the third quarter of 2026 for reduction codes 8320, 8321 and 8322.

For prior files, distinguish between hiring dates and opening dates of entitlement. ONSS indicates a minimum age of 57 years for hires from April 1, 2026 under code 8321. Salary ceilings and transitional rules must be verified in the instruction corresponding to the quarter declared.

The page signals an interim instruction of September 10, 2026. Entrust the payroll manager with verifying this update and the continuity of entitlement before DmfA. Do not promise a reduction based solely on the candidate's age.

title: SESAM: End of Applications and Monitoring of Awards
summary: No new SESAM application is possible since July 1, 2026. Existing awards remain monitored according to their decision, without automatic transfer to Job Plus.
body: The SPW update of September 24, 2026 confirms the end of new SESAM applications and replacement by the Job Plus incentive. Applications for extension or expansion had to be submitted no later than June 30, 2026.

An already-granted aid continues according to the conditions of the award decision, at the latest until December 31, 2029, if the obligations are met. Keep the decision and verify its requirements before any worker replacement or change in workforce.

No particular action is required to continue the normal monitoring of an ongoing SESAM with Le Forem. At the end of the award, any potential Job Plus aid requires a separate application; the worker does not automatically transfer.

title: APE: Verify Registration Before Hiring
summary: Since January 1, 2026, APE access is based in principle on four months of registration as a job seeker on the eve of hiring. Exceptions concern notably priority sectors and former APE workers.
body: Le Forem presents APE as subsidies intended for employers in the non-profit sector, local authorities and education located in Wallonia. This regime does not constitute general aid to all commercial enterprises.

For hires under rules that entered into force on January 1, 2026, verify the four months of registration required. Certain situations allow reducing the duration to one day, notably in healthcare, personal assistance, early childhood, culture and education.

Persons who have already worked under APE status benefit from direct access, regardless of sector, subject to residence in Belgium. Use the Le Forem calculator on the eve of hiring and also verify that the employer has the relevant subsidy.

title: APE: Reform Announced for 2027
summary: The Government has announced integration of APE support into sectoral policies starting in 2027. The March 2026 communique describes a draft adopted in first reading, not itself a finally published rule.
body: The communique regarding the decision of March 19, 2026 announces the repeal of the APE scheme as of January 1, 2027. It specifies that the Government adopted in first reading a draft framework decree organizing employment support through sectoral policies.

The draft notably provides for publication of beneficiaries, allocation criteria and coordination with the Wallonia-Brussels Federation. To prepare for hiring financed beyond 2026, obtain confirmation of funding and sectoral rules applicable from the subsidizing authority.
This sheet documents the official announcement and its planned schedule. It does not allow eliminating an APE right in progress in September 2026 or guaranteeing a candidate the same funding in 2027.

title: AViQ: Integration Bonus for a Disabled Worker
summary: AViQ can reimburse 25% of the salary cost for one year for a hire or return to work meeting its conditions. Submit the application with the worker's agreement before hiring or within three months following.
body: The sheet published on April 18, 2024 requires AViQ recognition and an employment contract or public status. For hiring, it notably targets professional inactivity of at least six months over the preceding nine months. It also provides for return after incapacity or a reintegration decision.

The 25% reimbursement is based on the remuneration admissible at the company's expense, including the gross, capped if necessary at 150% of the guaranteed minimum average monthly income, and employer contributions taken into account. The maximum duration indicated is one year.

Address the application to the competent regional office according to the worker's residence. The contribution is liquidated quarterly on supporting documents. Also examine mentoring, position adjustment and adjustment of working conditions with AViQ, as each aid has its own cumulative conditions.

title: Distributing an Offer to Le Forem: Content and Responsibilities
summary: The terms of distribution through Le Forem APIs require real, accurate and non-discriminatory offers. They are particularly useful to a recruiter posting for its clients or from HR software.
body: The updated terms of December 12, 2023 require a request for access and identifiers issued by Le Forem. The service allows automatic transmission of offers managed for the company or its clients. These conditions concern this distribution channel.

Point 5 notably requires the function and its description, number of positions, location, job category, sector, contract, work regime, qualifications or experience, language, publication date and application procedures. Use Le Forem nomenclatures.

Remove the ad as soon as the position is no longer really available. Points 9 to 11 recall equal treatment, Collective Agreement No. 38 and data protection. Le Forem can refuse an inadequate ad and suspend access in case of non-compliance; the user remains responsible for the content.

title: Single Permit: Prepare the Application and Evidence of Shortage
summary: For a foreign worker subject to authorization, prepare the work and residence file before employment. In the general category, also justify the impossibility of recruiting from the available labor market.
body: The framework of the Walloon Decree of June 6, 2024 applies since September 1, 2024. The SPW page provides for the single permit for employment of more than 90 days and its electronic submission by the employer or its agent on Working in Belgium. First verify any possible exemptions and particular categories.

Prepare notably passport, signed contract, diploma, proof of access to a regulated profession if necessary, and residence documents. The contract must specify the position and its classification, location, duration, schedule, remuneration and joint committee, in accordance with article 15.

Article 2 notably allows relying on the specific list of occupations in shortage or a certificate from Le Forem after an ad published for at least five weeks, also distributed via EURES. The page also provides for active management and pre-selection by Le Forem. Obtain proof before submitting the application.

title: Shortages for Work Permit: 2025-2026 List
summary: The specific list for third-country nationals applies from October 1, 2025 to September 30, 2026 inclusive. It is still valid at the date of this search, but must be re-verified for a later application.
body: The annex published by SPW targets occupations in shortage in the French-speaking region for the admission to work of a third-country national. It implements article 2, § 2, paragraph 1, 1°, and § 4, paragraph 2, of the decree of the Walloon Government of June 6, 2024.

It cites notably construction manager, site manager, heavy metal structure fitter and industrial installation electrician. Compare the tasks of the position with the exact title of the annex; mere membership in the construction sector is not sufficient.

This list serves for the work authorization file. It does not exempt from the required permit or the professional conditions of the position. Its period ends on September 30, 2026: do not assume its renewal from the next day.

title: Le Forem: 144 Occupations in Shortage in 2026
summary: Le Forem publishes a list of 144 occupations in shortage for 2026 with a renewed method and nomenclature. Use it to prepare sourcing and training needed for recruitment.
body: The communique of July 1, 2026 explains the use of the Labor Needs survey and a global severity index. The new approach replaces the former binary distinction between occupations in shortage and critical functions; direct comparisons with 2025 therefore require caution.

Among the occupations presenting the strongest recruitment difficulties are roofer, healthcare assistant, mason and nurse. The communique notes 38 occupations in construction and 19 respectively in the technology industry and in healthcare and social action.

Consult the link to occupations and training to adapt the profile sought and consider training before hiring. This publication describes the labor market; for admission of a third-country national, use the separate regulatory list published by SPW.

title: PFI: Train Then Hire the Candidate
summary: The Training-Insertion Plan allows training a job seeker to the company's needs. The employer then commits to hiring them under contract for at least the duration of the training.
body: The Walloon sheet updated on August 11, 2026 provides for training of 4 to 26 weeks, organized in the company or partially in a training center. The company must have a headquarters of operation in Wallonia and the candidate be registered as an unemployed job seeker.

Plan from the start the contract that will follow the training, for a duration at least equivalent. The sheet signals variants for heavy truck, bus and coach drivers as well as Interim PFI. Have the arrangement validated by Le Forem before starting.

Do not reuse an old model of Walloon transition internship: the Decree of July 18, 2013 has been repealed and Wallex indicates an end of validity on June 29, 2017, on https://wallex.wallonie.be/eli/arrete/2013/07/18/2013204389. The PFI presented here is a distinct current scheme, with hiring obligation.
source: Public Service of Wallonia and Le Forem · wallonie.be

title: German-Speaking Region and Municipalities with Facilities: Language of Documents
summary: Do not automatically apply the 1982 French decree to all of Wallonia. The German-speaking region and municipalities with facilities are governed by the Coordinated Laws of July 18, 1966.
body: The SPF Employment recalls that the criterion is the operation headquarters to which the worker is assigned. For an establishment in the German-speaking region, the employer uses German for acts and documents intended for staff.

In municipalities with facilities in the Walloon Region, these documents are drafted in French, but the legal basis is federal. The Coordinated Laws entered into force on August 2, 1966. Verify the exact municipality before choosing the contract model; the geographic filter 'wallonie' includes here an area not covered by the French Community decree.
